create_mujoco_effector: create a MujocoEffector instance with a sequence of MuJoCo actuators and an optional prefix
set_actuator_control: set control commands on MuJoCo actuators by passing a numpy array to set_control
create_action_spec: create a BoundedArray action spec for MuJoCo actuators using their ctrlrange or an override
get_action_spec_from_effector: get the cached action spec from a MujocoEffector by calling action_spec with a physics object
override_action_range: override the default actuator ctrlrange by passing a list of min max tuples to create_action_spec
